name: When should my local business prioritize optimizing for AI Overviews?

mainEntity.name: When should my local business prioritize optimizing for AI Overviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your local business should prioritize optimizing for AI Overviews now, as they are becoming a prominent feature in Google Search. If your business relies on local search traffic, being featured in an AI Overview can provide a significant competitive advantage by directly answering searchers' queries. This optimization is especially crucial if your competitors are already appearing in these snippets or if your business offers services that are frequently searched for with informational queries. Proactive optimization ensures your business remains visible in an evolving search landscape.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize AI Overviews optimization now, especially if your business relies on local search, to gain a competitive advantage and maintain visibility.
